scenario.shared_setting: Four colleagues work in a small office in a commercial building and have worked together for two years. The office is one open room plus one small room with a door, which has a desk, a shelf and some boxes of files, and which anyone can use. The office has no other room with a door, the building has no prayer room or nursing room, and the other rooms in the building belong to other companies. You all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Natalie Rodrigues is Catholic, Marcus de Souza is Catholic, Rachel Pereira is Catholic, and Hui Min is Buddhist. It is mid-morning and all four are at their desks.
